subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: Should main-session automatic recovery use this cumulative three-attempt, no-expiry fuse, and should this PR be the sole canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95750?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and well-proven, but the retained-attempt policy deliberately trades automatic recovery availability for fail-closed safety, while another open PR proposes a different durable contract.

options.title: Approve this cumulative fuse
options.body: Choose this PR as canonical, accept quarantine after three accepted or acceptance-uncertain attempts regardless of elapsed time, and close the competing PR after merge.

options.title: Prefer a narrower policy
options.body: Require a maintainer-approved retention window or choose the competing implementation's simpler accounting contract before landing.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Keep the issue open while defining the permanent persisted state and non-technical operator recovery experience.

recommendation.title: Approve this cumulative fuse
recommendation.body: Choose this PR as canonical, accept quarantine after three accepted or acceptance-uncertain attempts regardless of elapsed time, and close the competing PR after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee, framed the policy boundary in review discussion, and authored the final recovery-state and concurrency changes.
